core_insight.finding: AI with random entry timing wins 69% when using LONG + tight TP + low acceptance

direction_rules.rationale: AI consistently performs better on LONG trades (48% vs 36% WR, +0.06R vs -0.09R EV)
when_to_go_SHORT: Only when ALL of these align:
- Price clearly near session high (within 20% of range from top)
when_to_go_LONG: - Price near session low OR mid-range

tp_sl_rules.critical: TIGHT TPs WIN. Wide TPs lose badly.

calculation.example: If SL is 15 pips, TP should be 18-22 pips (NOT 40+ pips)

tp_sl_rules.why_tight_works: Random entry timing means price often reverses before reaching distant TPs. Tight TPs capture the mean-reversion move.

risk_scaling.philosophy: Bet big on high-probability setups, tiny on low-probability

minimum_risk_0.15.note: Still take the trade but protect capital

red_flags_reduce_risk: RR target > 2.0 → force tighter TP instead
what_NOT_to_do: DO NOT set TP beyond 2.0R (historically 7% win rate)
DO NOT go SHORT unless conditions are perfect
DO NOT ignore acceptanceTime (most predictive indicator)
DO NOT use medium ATR setups aggressively
